T: The race that stops a nation.
D: The story of the champion racehorse who won the hearts of Depression-era Australia.
P: Serve the snacks when the Melbourne Cup starts.
S: Members' lawn cold lamb and mint sandwiches
Thin-sliced cold roast lamb, mint sauce and butter in soft white bread, crusts off.

Rub 500g lamb backstrap with oil, salt and pepper, sear 3 minutes a side in a hot pan and roast at 200C for 10 minutes, then rest 15 minutes and chill. Butter 8 slices of soft white bread, spread 4 slices with 3 tbsp mint sauce, top with the thinly sliced lamb, a handful of mint leaves and the other bread. Trim the crusts and cut into fingers.
Toasted baguette with chutney, vintage cheddar and red apple

Crisp toasts with vintage cheddar, thin apple slices, fruit chutney and a few thyme leaves, apples for Tommy and Big Red alike. Slice 1 baguette into 20 rounds, brush with oil and bake at 190C for 8 minutes. Thinly slice 2 red apples and toss in lemon juice. Spread each toast with a little fruit chutney, top with a slice of 200g vintage cheddar and a slice of apple. Finish with thyme leaves and cracked pepper.
M: Big Red's Cup day roast beef rolls
Cold roast beef, caramelised onion, rocket, beetroot and horseradish cream

Soft rolls piled with rare roast beef, horseradish cream, caramelised onion, rocket and pickled beetroot, the grand picnic for Cup Day. Rub a 1kg beef eye fillet or rump with oil, salt and pepper, sear all over and roast at 200C for 20 minutes for rare. Rest and chill, then slice thinly. Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in butter for 20 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish cream. Split 4 soft rolls, spread with horseradish cream and fill with beef, onions, rocket and sliced pickled beetroot.
Stud farm hideout chicken and potato salad
Cold roast chook and egg and chive potato salad, on the rug at Flemington
Chicken roasted the day before and served cold in pieces, with a potato salad of egg, chives and mayonnaise.
W: Jam lamingtons for Cup day. Chocolate, coconut, cream

Sponge squares split and filled with raspberry jam and cream, dipped in chocolate icing and rolled in coconut. Cut a 20cm square sponge cake into 16 squares and freeze 30 minutes. Mix 400g icing sugar, 40g cocoa, 20g melted butter and 150ml boiling water into a thin icing. Dip each square in the icing, let it drip, then roll in 150g desiccated coconut. Set for 30 minutes. Split each in half and fill with raspberry jam and whipped cream from 200ml thickened cream.
K: Tequila, pink grapefruit and lime with soda, raised to the Agua Caliente win

Tequila and fresh pink grapefruit with lime and soda in a salt-rimmed glass. Leave out the tequila for a grapefruit spritz. Rub a lime wedge around the rims of 4 tall glasses and dip in sea salt. Fill with ice. Add 45ml tequila, 90ml pink grapefruit juice and the juice of half a lime to each glass. Top with 60ml soda water and stir gently. Garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

dishes.n: Members' lawn cold lamb and mint sandwiches
dishes.make_ahead: Roast the lamb the day before; make the sandwiches up to 3 hours ahead under a damp cloth

steps.text: Rub the lamb with oil, salt and pepper and sear in a hot pan.
Roast at 200C, then rest and chill.
Butter the bread, spread half with mint sauce and layer the thinly sliced lamb and mint.
Top with the remaining bread, trim the crusts and cut into fingers.

veg.n: Members' lawn minted pea and feta sandwiches (vegetarian)

steps.text: Simmer the peas for 3 minutes, drain and cool.
Mash the peas with the feta, lemon juice, chopped mint, salt and pepper.
Butter the bread and spread half with the pea mash.
Top with the remaining bread, trim the crusts and cut into fingers.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sandwiches up to 3 hours ahead under a damp cloth

steps.text: Slice the baguette into rounds and brush with oil.
Bake at 190C until crisp.
Thinly slice the apples and toss in lemon juice.
Spread each toast with a little fruit chutney, top with cheddar and a slice of apple.
Finish with thyme leaves and cracked pepper.

Sear all over.
Roast at 200C for rare.
Rest, then chill before slicing thinly.
Slice the onions.
Slowly fry the onions in butter.
Mix the sour cream with horseradish cream.

veg.n: Big Red's Cup day roast mushroom rolls
veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms up to 1 day ahead, assemble fresh

steps.text: Rub the mushrooms with the oil, soy sauce, salt and pepper.
Roast at 200C until tender and juicy, then cool and slice.
Slice the onions.
Slowly fry the onions in butter.
Mix the sour cream with horseradish cream.
Split the rolls, spread with horseradish cream and fill with mushrooms, onions, rocket and sliced pickled beetroot.

dishes.n: Stud farm hideout chicken and potato salad
dishes.make_ahead: Roast the chicken and make the potato salad 1 day ahead; both are served cold

steps.text: Rub the chicken with oil and salt, put the halved lemon inside and roast at 200C until the juices run clear.
Boil the potatoes until tender with the eggs in for the first 10 minutes. Drain and cool.
Peel and chop the eggs and fold through the potatoes with the mayonnaise, mustard and chopped chives.
Chill the chicken, then cut into pieces and pack with the potato salad.

veg.n: Stud farm hideout egg and potato salad
veg.make_ahead: Make 1 day ahead and serve cold

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender with the eggs in for the first 10 minutes. Drain and cool.
Peel the eggs, halve four and chop the rest.
Fold the potatoes and chopped egg through the mayonnaise, mustard and chives. Serve on cos leaves with the halved eggs and lemon.
Cut the sponge cake into squares.
Freeze the squares for 30 minutes.
Mix the icing sugar, cocoa, melted butter and boiling water into a thin icing.
Dip each square in the icing, let it drip, then roll in desiccated coconut.
Set for 30 minutes.
Whip the cream.
Split each in half and fill with raspberry jam and whipped cream.
Rub a lime wedge around the rims of tall glasses and dip in sea salt.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Add tequila, grapefruit juice and lime juice to each glass.
Top with soda water and stir gently.
Garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

Fill the glasses with ice.
Add grapefruit juice, lime juice and agave to each glass and stir.
